name: Y Combinator (standard deal)
amountText: US$500,000 (about ₹4.25 crore): $125,000 for a fixed 7% plus $375,000 on an uncapped MFN SAFE. Converted at about ₹85 per US dollar.
equity: 7% for $125k + uncapped MFN SAFE for $375k (converts at your next priced round or lowest-cap SAFE)
duration: 3-month programme in San Francisco; YC stays a shareholder for life
timeToMoney: Fast: YC says it invests as soon as a company is accepted. Applications to decision is roughly 4–6 weeks for on-time applicants.

oneLiner: The world's best-known startup accelerator: it invests US$500,000 in your company in exchange for equity and runs a 3-month programme in San Francisco.
what: YC is not a grant. It buys a slice of your company. Every accepted company gets $500,000: $125,000 for a fixed 7% stake and $375,000 on an uncapped SAFE that converts later on the best terms you give any other early investor. In return you get three months of intense coaching in San Francisco, Demo Day in front of hundreds of investors, and the YC alumni network.

Teams willing to spend the batch in person in San Francisco

notFor: Anyone looking for free money: this is an equity investment
Founders who cannot travel to the US for three months (visa delays are your problem to solve)
Service agencies or consulting businesses without a scalable product
Companies that do not want a US investor on their cap table (YC typically expects a US parent company, often a Delaware C-Corp)
why: YC's name opens doors with top US investors and early customers
The money arrives quickly and is not tied to milestones
Demo Day can lead to a seed round within weeks
The alumni network becomes your first customers and advisors
howItWorks: You apply online with a short written application and a one-minute founder video. YC partners read applications and invite promising teams to a short video interview, usually in November–December for the winter batch. Decisions usually come the same day as the interview, and YC says it invests as soon as you accept. During the batch you meet partners regularly, set weekly goals and finish with Demo Day.

steps.detail: YC runs four batches a year (winter, spring, summer, fall). Apply before the deadline for a guaranteed decision date, or use Early Decision for a later batch.

steps.title: Interview
steps.detail: If shortlisted, a 10-minute video call with YC partners. Know your numbers and users cold.

steps.title: Decision and paperwork
steps.detail: Decisions usually arrive the same day. Accepting means signing the SAFEs; YC may ask you to set up a US company structure.

steps.title: Join the batch
steps.detail: Move to San Francisco for three months, build, talk to users, and pitch at Demo Day.
